_comment: Release manifest for AbilityKit framework packages. Drives tools/publish/release.js. Edit batches/status here, then run release.js to tag.

neverReleased._comment: These prefixes are vendored (thirdparty) or samples (demo) and are never released.

batches._comment: status: candidate (awaiting stability sign-off) -> ready (cleared to tag) -> shipped (tagged).
batches.description: Initial framework cohort for validating the registry and tag pipeline. Includes Deterministic to satisfy Core's internal dependency.
Upstream packages for Triggering. Candidate preview includes the foundation batch until the required exact-version local tags exist.
First stable Triggering candidate. Requires an installable dependency closure and separate clean-consumer and Player evidence before sign-off.
